---
title: "Methods Hub Submission Guidelines"
subtitle: "How to contribute a method or tutorial"
---

Are you interested in contributing a method or tutorial to the [Methods Hub](https://methodshub.gesis.org)? These pages answer the following questions:

- What are the [aim and scope](scope.qmd) of the Methods Hub?
- What qualifies as a [method](scope.qmd#methods) and what as a [tutorial](scope.qmd#tutorials)?
- What are the Methods Hub's [submission criteria](criteria.qmd)?
- Ready for submission? Follow the [submission checklist](checklist.qmd).
- Still unsure? Read the [FAQ](faq.qmd).
- Where and how can you get [support](support.qmd)?

::: {.callout-tip}
## Every published item gets a DOI
Everything published on the Methods Hub receives a DOI, which makes your method or tutorial citable.
:::
